name: Tenraku no In-On Shoujo
source:
The story follows two girls, a senpai and her junior from the light music club, who fall into a lascivious trap after school activities. Unable to resist, both are dragged into a whirlwind of extreme sexual situations, including forced acts and the loss of their virginity to strangers. As their bodies and minds are corroded, the protagonists face a turning point that will determine their destiny.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ063460.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述轻音乐社的一名学姐与学妹，她们在社团活动后掉进淫荡陷阱。两人无法抵抗，被卷入极端色情处境，包括被迫行为，以及失去处女之身。随着身心被侵蚀，主人公们迎来决定命运的转折点。
